## ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A priedo kontrolių būklė
Paskutinio sėkmingo rinkimo ciklo rezultatai. Duomenys: EvidenceResult_CL, EvidenceCycle_CL.

content.query:
let lastCycle = toscalar(EvidenceCycle_CL | where Status in ('Succeeded', 'Partial') | top 1 by StartTime desc | project CycleId);
EvidenceResult_CL
| where CycleId == lastCycle
| summarize Neatitinka = countif(Result == 'neatitinka'), Istekliu = count(), PaskutinisIrodymas = max(CollectedAt) by Kontrole = ControlId, Pavadinimas = ControlName
| extend Bukle = iff(Neatitinka > 0, 'neatitinka', 'atitinka')
| project Kontrole, Pavadinimas, Bukle, Neatitinka, Istekliu, PaskutinisIrodymas
| order by Kontrole asc

EvidenceCycle_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project StartTime, Status, DurationSec, RecordCount, Throttled, Error
| order by StartTime desc
